name: Shephi
title: Descendant of Benjamin
summary: Shephi was a descendant of Benjamin through Elpaal's lineage. He is mentioned in 1 Chronicles as one of the heads of the families in the tribe of Benjamin who lived in Jerusalem. He is part of the detailed genealogies that connect the tribes of Israel throughout history.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the Genealogy of Benjamin
keyEvents.description: Shephi is listed as a son of Shimei in the genealogy of the tribe of Benjamin, as part of the families who settled in Jerusalem.

keyEvents.title: Family Heads in Benjamin
keyEvents.description: Shephi is counted among the family heads in the tribe of Benjamin, who played an important role in Israel's tribal structure.

keyEvents.title: Connection to Jerusalem
keyEvents.description: As part of the tribe of Benjamin, Shephi's family lived in Jerusalem, showing the tribe's closeness to the holy city.

keyEvents.title: Part of Israel's Family History
keyEvents.description: Shefi is included in the extensive genealogies of 1 Chronicles, which were compiled to document Israel's tribal affiliation after returning from exile.
